cells.gaps: The source does not attribute the 74.8% to a survey; no survey share of adults with an account has been found, and none at 79% or more.
cells.note: The Central Bank of Egypt puts Egyptians aged 15 and over actively using financial accounts at 74.8% at the end of 2024, over half. The bank does not say the figure comes from a survey; staged on it as the ladder is read now.
